test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

**__Trivial__** issues have always interested our boss.
solution: The correct answer is **"Significant."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Trivial"** means unimportant or insignificant. (महत्वहीन, मामूली; नगण्य, तुच्‍छ) • **Example:** *It is a **trivial**__ problem.* • **"Significant"** means important or meaningful. (महत्वपूर्ण, काफ़ी बड़ा (इतना कि दीख जाए)) __ • **Example:** *This is a **significant**__ issue.* • The antonym of **"Trivial"** is **"Significant."** • So, the correct answer is** Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Fierce"** means aggressive or violent. (क्रुद्घ, आक्रामक और डरावना; बर्बर) • **"Hopeful"** means optimistic or positive. (आशा रखने वाला, आशावान) • **"Common"** means ordinary or usual. (प्रायः या बहुत सारे स्‍थानों पर पाया जाने या होने वाला; सामान्‍य, आम) 3b:Tc5c, The correct answer is **"Mr. Gupta had not posted the article."**
